title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Oxygen-rich polyoxometalate fragments can act as multidentate inorganic ligands that assemble and support redox-active 3d-metal cluster sites.
explanation: The review surveys Co-, Mn-, Ni-, Cu-, and Fe-containing POM clusters whose metal-oxo frameworks organize multiple transition-metal centers for photocatalytic water oxidation or hydrogen evolution.
caveats: The presence of multiple metal sites does not by itself establish catalytic superiority or molecular stability.
